title: 富达托马斯：韩国杠杆ETF泡沫，AI基建支出或成浪费

segments.en: I'm going to miss sure you know South Korea is up 100% year-to-date there's some bubbles going on in terms of the leverage ETF stocks that are going that are happening there but I mean it does seem like some of the froth will get taken out of this eventually
segments.zh: 韩国市场今年涨幅已达100%，杠杆ETF领域出现泡沫。但泡沫终将被挤出。

segments.en: but I mean this AI tech thing is a real trade but I think the narrative around like the more companies spend on infrastructure is a good thing like I don't think that's the right narrative because eventually you'll see consolidation in some of those AI tech names right and so not everyone can win
segments.zh: AI科技是真实交易，但认为公司增加基建支出就是好事的叙事并不正确，因为最终会出现整合，并非所有公司都能赢。

segments.en: and so I think some of this CapEx is actually going to be wasted money Thomas I want to pick up on your point about some of that froth fair I mean you
segments.zh: 所以我认为部分资本支出实际上会被浪费。关于泡沫的问题，我想继续探讨。
